Sometime prior to the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Jefand Ange]] led an '''extermination campaign''' against the [[Gen'Dai homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Billions died, and most of the few who survived were enslaved by the Empire.<ref name="Old Republic" />
